data.title: Train Yard: Cargo and Passenger Routes
data.description: Learn how different trains carry people and goods across the countryside.

challenges.title: Farm Harvest Run
challenges.instruction: Move 1,380 tons of grain from Sunny Valley Farm to City Flour Mill. Choose the kind of car that can carry grain. The yard couples the cars and the engines.

challenges.title: Morning Commuter Express
challenges.instruction: Move 1,740 commuters from Maple Wood Suburb to Central Station. The yard has the right kind of car ready and adds the engines. Couple the fewest cars that hold the whole load.

challenges.title: Forest Timber Haul
challenges.instruction: The yard has loaded 1,720 tons of lumber into the cars for the trip from Pine Tree Sawmill to Big City Builder. The route climbs Pine Ridge Pass, a 1.0% grade. Add the fewest engines that pull the train up the hill.

challenges.title: Fuel Delivery Train
challenges.instruction: Build a train to move 1,240 tons of heating oil from River Refinery to Town Fuel Depot. The route climbs Copper Mountain, a 3.0% grade. Use the fewest cars and engines that get the whole load there.
